answer.rationale: Rollback is disallowed by compliance despite memory_b1. Circuit breaking (memory_b4) fails requests and would drop settlement writes. Regional failover (memory_b2) is unindicated and risks in-flight writes at peak. Route-to-replicas (memory_b5) only helps if report/read load is the contention source, which is not observed; traffic is write-heavy. The remaining write-safe lever is headroom (memory_b3): a security patch can raise per-write cost so the daily settlement peak now exceeds prior capacity. Uncertain whether this is a capacity regression versus a defect that more boxes cannot fix; verifying b3 because that win was pre-peak provisioning, not a mid-surge add.
